title: Free Love / Bus shelter

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Check a campaign in its actual viewing environment because a poster competes with street furniture and traffic.
strategic_value: The luminous pink panel can make the invitation visible within an ordinary city route.
demonstration: A photograph shows the FREE LOVE poster in an illuminated bus shelter at a street corner.
practical_value: Assess the poster’s contrast and reading distance in a real outdoor placement.

content_islands.name: Poster panel
content_islands.spec: Keep the pink poster as the bright center of the shelter.

content_islands.name: Street context
content_islands.spec: Retain roadway, bicycle rack and surrounding buildings to show the viewing conditions.

reference_purposes.Expression: A photograph shows the FREE LOVE poster in an illuminated bus shelter at a street corner.
reference_purposes.Application: The campaign is shown installed in an illuminated bus-shelter panel.
